prior_hypothesis.hypothesis: A global normal-patient PCA reference improved CV, but regional weighting and finer regions did not preserve validation and CV together. Test an input-conditional normal reference: mix locally weighted tangent spaces based only on normal-patient nuisance coordinates. This tests heterogeneity of normal feature distributions; no disease labels enter the atlas.
prior_hypothesis.geometry: Original fit-only standardization. Equal normal-patient centers. Fit global normalPCA32 and whiten its coordinates for deterministic farthest-initialized Lloyd clustering2/4,max100withconvergenceassert. Gate distance is mean32coordinate squared distance,bandwidth mean nearest-normal-patient-center distance. Softmax(-distance/(temperature*bandwidth)). Percluster covariance uses .25uniformnormalpatientweights+.75normalizedresponsibility and rank32 for each of4streams; query samegate mixes local orthogonal projection corrections. Freeze16arm/phase geometry and16patientplans before allfits.
